The '''''Platinum'' arc''' (Japanese: '''プラチナ編''' ''Platinum arc''), also referred to as '''''The Eighth Chapter''''' (Japanese: '''第八章''' ''The Eighth Chapter''), is the eighth story arc of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] {{pkmn|manga}}, consisting of three volumes. It began serialization in March 2009, and ended in July 2010.

This arc follows {{adv|Platinum}} as she enters the {{Gdis|Battle Frontier|IV}} to gather information on the mysterious [[Distortion World]] so she can rescue her original bodyguards [[Paka and Uji]]. Joining Platinum is {{adv|Looker}}, a member of the [[International Police]], who aims to investigate the villainous [[Team Galactic]]. Meanwhile, {{adv|Diamond}} and {{adv|Pearl}} set out to protect Sinnoh's [[Legendary Pokémon]] from Team Galactic's new leader, [[Charon]].

== Terminology ==
{{main|Terminology of Pokémon Adventures}}
This arc gets its name from the [[Core series|core series game]], [[Pokémon Platinum Version|Pokémon Platinum]].

==Important events==
{{spoilers}}
{{main|Timeline of events in Pokémon Adventures#Platinum arc|Timeline of events in the Platinum arc of Pokémon Adventures}}
* Two weeks have passed since the end of the {{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}.
* {{adv|Platinum}} arrives at the [[Battle Zone]] and meets {{adv|Looker}}.
* Platinum starts to challenge the {{gdis|Battle Frontier|IV}} to gather information on the [[Distortion World]].
* {{adv|Diamond}} and {{adv|Pearl}} set out on a journey with [[Dr. Footstep]] and the Sinnoh Pokémon Association Chairman.
* [[Charon]] captures {{p|Heatran}}.
* [[Palmer]] is revealed to be Pearl's father.
* Diamond and Pearl part ways with their companions. They meet {{p|Rotom}} again, and it joins their group.
* {{adv|Giratina}} appears in [[Eterna City]].
* Diamond is hit by Giratina's {{m|Shadow Force}} while saving Pearl. His body disappears.
* Platinum enters the Distortion World together with Palmer, Riley, Mira, and Cheryl.
* Diamond finds himself in Distortion World and meets [[Cyrus]].
* {{adv|Dialga}} and {{adv|Palkia}} are freed.
* [[Paka and Uji|Paka, Uji]], Diamond, Pearl, and Platinum reunite.
* Giratina appears and is defeated in [[Sunyshore City]]. Charon is arrested by Looker.
* Cyrus disbands Team Galactic.
* Looker is called to the [[Unova]] region.
* Looker gives Diamond Manaphy's Egg.
